text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yahoo, Curren-chan! Why are you looking 
all around?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yahoo~â I've decided where to stream 
today.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ah—! That Umastagram post! It was trending 
with '#CurrenBirthday'!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
That's amazing... Even though it's your 
own birthday, you're still giving fan 
service to everyone.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You think so? All of my fans are amazing 
too! They never fail to leave comments for 
me.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure they have hard times with work or 
school too... Yet they still come out to 
support Curren.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
So today is a day of celebration for 
Curren and eveeeeryone♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Curren-chan... you're so cool...! Like a 
true professional, or totally a woman who 
gets things done!?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Maya wants to do something too! I 
wanna help out!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you~! In that case... maybe I could 
ask you to join in as a guest?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure everyone's gonna love a stream 
with Curren's precious friend♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Leave it to me! Maya's gonna 
liven things up big time☆
